subject: general
question:
Read the sentence carefully and select the most suitable idiom to fill in the blank.

Extreme inflation in the country has led to a hike in the price of day-to-day commodity. It has made it difficult to __________.

options.text: costs an arm and a leg

solution:
The correct answer is '**keep body and soul together**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**keep body and soul together**" means to manage to stay alive with just enough of the necessities of life. (मुश्किलों के बावजूद जीवित रहना)
 
• Given the context of extreme inflation and increased prices, it indicates the struggle to survive.
 
• The other options: "**a blessing in disguise**," "**costs an arm and a leg**," and "**break a leg**" do not fit the context appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Extreme inflation in the country has led to a hike in the price of day-to-day commodity. It has made it difficult to keep body and soul together__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **A blessing in disguise**: an apparent misfortune that eventually has good results.
 
• **Costs an arm and a leg**: very expensive.
 
• **Break a leg**: a way to wish someone good luck.
